vulnerable_code:
class PatentsController < ApplicationController
  def download_blueprint
    @patent = Patent.find(params[:id])
    # Missing company tenancy check before issuing Active Storage blob redirect
    redirect_to rails_blob_path(@patent.blueprint_pdf, disposition: 'attachment')
  end
end
diagnosis: The download_blueprint action retrieves a Patent by ID and immediately redirects to its Active Storage blueprint_pdf attachment without checking if the requester belongs to the patent-holding organization. Competitors can download proprietary CAD blueprints and patent disclosures prior to public release.
exploit_request:
GET /api/patents/pat_4401/blueprint HTTP/1.1
Host: ip.techcorp-rnd.com
Authorization: Bearer rival_company_token_88
Accept: application/pdf
corrected_code:
class PatentsController < ApplicationController
  def download_blueprint
    @patent = Patent.find(params[:id])
    authorize @patent, :download_blueprint?

    redirect_to rails_blob_path(@patent.blueprint_pdf, disposition: 'attachment')
  end
end
